description: Pluggable draw-result ingestion sources for the Vietlott skill. The ingester (scripts/ingest_results.py) reads the active source per game, normalizes draws to the schema in data/results.schema.json, dedupes by draw_id, sorts by date, and writes data/results/<game>.jsonl. Real data takes precedence; the synthetic source is a faithful offline/CI fixture (draws sampled from the exact Vietlott distributions) and is NEVER presented as real history.

mega_6_45.comment: Columns: date(YYYY-MM-DD),draw_id,n1,n2,n3,n4,n5,n6. Populate from https://vietlott.vn results pages. Set active:true to use.
Optional: any JSON endpoint returning {draws:[{date,numbers:[...]}]}. Configure url + parser to your source.

official_site_note: The official site https://vietlott.vn renders results via an AjaxPro (AJAX.NET) handler that requires session/anti-forgery tokens and changes without notice, so it is NOT used as a default automated source. To ingest real data reliably: download or copy results from the official 'Ket qua trung thuong' / 'Thong ke' pages into the matching data/raw/<game>.csv template (one draw per row) and set that source active:true. The ingester validates and normalizes whatever real CSV you supply.
